key_insight: StrataFlux selectively streams extra precision from host RAM and SSDs to recover low-bit LLM accuracy while largely preserving quantization’s memory and speed benefits.
engineering_relevance: Memory-hierarchy-aware inference can support accurate models and long contexts with less GPU memory, without requiring all precision data to remain GPU-resident.
method: Co-design refinement representation, selection, and delivery for low-bit weights and KV caches.
Selectively stream additional precision from host RAM and SSDs.
Overlap transfers with computation and reuse fetched precision across decoding steps.
evidence_signal: Across dedicated-GPU and unified-memory evaluations, StrataFlux reduced 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 at 95.4% of base throughput on RTX 5090 and raised Qwen3-8B AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use.
watch_item: Benefits may depend on host-memory and SSD bandwidth, transfer scheduling, and how effectively fetched precision can be reused.
